title: Jain-friendly eggless cakes for Rosehill and Camellia, made in Harris Park
summary:
A Jain family in Rosehill shouldn't have to ask twice whether a cake has egg in it. Every cake we bake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake — which is why the answer is always the same, before you even ask.

Camellia and Rosehill sit less than 10 minutes from our Wigram Street kitchen in Harris Park. Six sizes, 15 flavours, fondant or buttercream, any design you send us. 48 hours minimum notice — that's what fresh baking actually takes.
